notes.title: Update!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768479/4e7d753492488e4c4e1be344843d39ae218f8097.png"][/img] [b]Hello, dear friends![/b][/p][p]We’re releasing the very first [b]major update[/b] since the game’s launch! In addition to fixing reported bugs and making other adjustments, this update adds a brand-new options button to the main menu and pause screen, giving access to the following features:[/p][p][/p][p]· [b]Casual Mode[/b]: a game mode with infinite energy, perfect for kids and for anyone who wants to enjoy the adventure without big challenges. It can be enabled or disabled at any time through the options menu (available on both the pause screen and main menu).[/p][p]· [b]Windowed Mode[/b]: allows you to switch at any time between fullscreen and windowed mode through the options menu (available on both the pause screen and main menu).[/p][p]· [b]How to Play[/b]: short tutorials demonstrating all gameplay features, accessible at any time through the options menu (available on both the pause screen and main menu).[/p][p][/p][p]A big thank-you to everyone who has been supporting the return of our beloved Sapo Xulé![/p][p][b]Big hugs![/b]
Squash Studios Team[/p]

notes.title: Now available!!!!!
notes.content:
[p][b]It’s been a long road, but finally [i]“Sapo Xulé and he Unwanted Marriage”[/i] is now on STEAM![/b]
Take advantage of the special launch price.[/p][p]We sincerely thank everyone who has followed us on this journey.
If you purchase the game, we kindly ask you to leave a positive review on the STEAM store page — it really helps us reach more and more players.[/p][p]A big hug to all,
[b]The Squash Studios Team & Sapo Xulé![/b][/p]

notes.title: Release Date: July 21, 2025
notes.content: [p]                               [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768479/d1c7b5cf0c682dc3f33badaa60cb536d81e42dd2.gif"][/img][/p][p]Hello everyone! We can finally reveal: "Sapo Xulé and the Unwanted Wedding" will be released on July 21, 2025.[/p][p][/p][p]Those who purchase the game will also have access to the official soundtrack![/p][p][/p][p]Watch the new trailer below on the store page![/p][p]Greetings to all![/p][p]Sapo Xulé and the Squash Studios Team.[/p]
